SELECT PPU.UPCOMING_ID, PPU.BP_ID, PPU.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_CODE, PPU.INSPECTION_TYPE, PPU.APPOINTED_DATE, PPU.REMIND_DATE, PPU.ENABLE_FLAG, PPU.STATUS, PPU.DESCRIPTION, (SELECT meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'PLI.INSPECTION_TYPE' and code_value = PPU.INSPECTION_TYPE)INSPECTION_TYPE_N
FROM PLM_PLI_UPCOMING PPU LEFT JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON PPU.BP_ID = HBM.BP_ID WHERE PPU.STATUS = 'Y' AND PPU.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND to_char PPU.REMIND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= to_char sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
AND PPU.INSPECTION_TYPE='OFF_SITE_INSPECT_PLAN'
AND PPU.INSPECTION_TYPE!='OFF_SITE_INSPECT_PLAN'

SELECT PPU.UPCOMING_ID, PPU.BP_ID, PPU.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_CODE, PPU.INSPECTION_TYPE, PPU.APPOINTED_DATE, PPU.REMIND_DATE, PPU.ENABLE_FLAG, PPU.STATUS, PPU.DESCRIPTION, ppu.appointed_date||'年' appointed_year, ppu.appointed_date ||'月' appointed_month, (select v.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'PLM.INSPECTION_TYPE' and v.code_value = PPU.inspection_type) as inspection_type_n
FROM PLM_PLI_UPCOMING PPU LEFT JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON PPU.BP_ID = HBM.BP_ID WHERE PPU.STATUS = 'Y' AND PPU.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND to_char PPU.REMIND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) <= to_char sysdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD' )
